              In Design Project III, offered in the 7th and 8th terms, you will complete the course work in the Department of Applied Chemistry through problem-based learning. In Preparatory Seminar of Design Project III, you will review safety lessons and engineering ethics as well as the basic knowledge needed to conduct a Design Project III. You also will learn how to implement project activities and prepare an implementation plan.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will help you prepare for your graduation research project (Design Project III). You will clarify your research objectives and prepare an experimental plan for Design Project III. You also will develop a plan to acquire the knowledge and skills necessary for performing the research. You will research the subject you choose and summarize the background, problem, objectives, experimental and analysis methods, and anticipated results.
